name: Alaska Airlines
note: Post-Hawaiian merger. Fee schedule is keyed to TICKETING date, not travel date — the current North America table applies to flights ticketed on or after 2026-04-10, and Alaska still publishes two older tables for tickets issued before then. Loyalty is now Atmos Rewards. Fees also vary by region: intra-Hawaii is cheaper than the rest of North America, and several international routes carry a free first bag.

baggage.label: Checked bags, North America
caveats: Main Cabin and Saver fares, travel within North America (including Central America and Hawaii). Fees are per direction.
Intra-Hawaii is cheaper: 30 USD first bag, 40 USD second.
The schedule is keyed to when the ticket was ISSUED, not when you fly. These figures apply to tickets issued on or after 10 April 2026; Alaska publishes separate tables for earlier tickets.
Free first bag for Atmos Rewards status holders and Atmos Rewards Visa cardholders when the fare is purchased with the card. Business and First include two bags at 70 lb.

Alaska or Hawaiian flight numbers can still fall under a partner's baggage rules. Codeshare flights in several number ranges (Qantas, British Airways, American, Japan Airlines and others) are governed by the operating carrier's policy, not this table.
Separate tickets are separate journeys. Bags are only checked to the final destination of the first ticket, and each carrier's fees apply again.
